lesson.text: Quick memory: what goes into a socket? (Only a plug.) Today: water, plugs, cables, sockets and power lines.
Water lets electricity through, and through you. Dry hands always, and keep hair dryers and radios far from the bath and the basin.
Unplug by holding the plug, never by pulling the cable: that can break the wires inside. A damaged cable: don't touch it, tell a grown-up.
One adaptor in a socket at most: never an adaptor in an adaptor. Big things like heaters go straight into the wall.
Power lines and substations carry a lot of electricity. Never fly kites or climb trees near them, and never go into a substation, even for a ball.
Try it in the world: open the practice house and the practice park. Next: the fuse box and a fallen power line, on the Big track.

exercises.prompt: You unplug a lamp by pulling...
Wet hands on a plug are fine if you are quick.
A substation's sign says DANGER. Your ball went in. You...
exercises.explain: Tell a grown-up: the power company gets it.

exercises.prompt: How many adaptors in one socket?
You can climb a tree that grows under the power lines.
exercises.explain: False: only trees far from power lines.

exercises.prompt: A lamp's cable has its wires showing. You...
choices: tell a grown-up and don't touch it
exercises.hint: Damaged cables can give a shock.
exercises.explain: Don't touch: a grown-up unplugs it and gets it mended.

exercises.prompt: Do it, or never do it?
items: fly a kite in an open field
exercises.hint: Think of water, wires and lines.
exercises.explain: Dry hands and open fields: yes. Pulling cables and substations: never.

exercises.prompt: Using a hair dryer after a bath: put it in order.
items: use it far from the bath
exercises.explain: Dry hands, far from the bath, then unplug by the plug.

exercises.prompt: Why never an adaptor in an adaptor?
choices: too many plugs can overheat the socket
exercises.explain: It can overheat and start a fire.

exercises.prompt: A kite string near power lines can carry electricity.
exercises.explain: True: let go and leave it.

exercises.prompt: Your friend wants to fetch a kite from the lines. You say...
choices: leave it: a grown-up calls the power company
exercises.hint: Not for a child to do.
exercises.explain: Leave it and tell a grown-up.
